mewtwo-psystrike.name: Psystrike
mewtwo-psystrike.description: Bond skill: materialized psychic waves up to 3 hexes away (Power 110, Sp. Atk).

mewtwo-barrier.name: Barrier
mewtwo-barrier.description: Bond skill: raises a psychic barrier around itself: Fortified for 3 turns.

mewtwo-telekinetic-focus.name: Telekinetic Focus
mewtwo-telekinetic-focus.description: Its Psychic moves deal 15% more damage.

mewtwo-engineered-body.name: Engineered Body
mewtwo-engineered-body.description: A body built in a lab: cannot be Poisoned or Burned.

mewtwo-cold-calculation.name: Cold Calculation
mewtwo-cold-calculation.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.

mewtwo-kinetic-barrier.name: Kinetic Barrier
mewtwo-kinetic-barrier.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

mewtwo-psycho-cut.name: Psycho Cut
mewtwo-psycho-cut.description: New skill: tears at a foe with blades formed by its mind (Power 75).

mewtwo-psychic-dominance.name: Psychic Dominance
mewtwo-psychic-dominance.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

mewtwo-teleport.name: Teleport
mewtwo-teleport.description: Blinks away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

mewtwo-overwhelming-power.name: Overwhelming Power
mewtwo-overwhelming-power.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

mewtwo-future-sight.name: Future Sight
mewtwo-future-sight.description: New skill: foresees a psychic strike on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 85).

mewtwo-merciless-mind.name: Merciless Mind
mewtwo-merciless-mind.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes carrying any status.

mewtwo-iron-will.name: Iron Will
mewtwo-iron-will.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

mewtwo-strongest-pokemon.name: Strongest Pokémon
mewtwo-strongest-pokemon.description: Capstone. Deals 15% more damage; a knockout resets its skill cooldowns.

mewtwo-psychic-overlord.name: Psychic Overlord
mewtwo-psychic-overlord.description: Capstone. Its ranged moves reach 1 hex farther; deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

mewtwo-regenerator.name: Regenerator
mewtwo-regenerator.description: Its engineered cells knit together: heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

mewtwo-agility.name: Agility
mewtwo-agility.description: Bond skill: relaxes and lightens its body, becoming Hasted for 3 turns.

mewtwo-psybeam.name: Psybeam
mewtwo-psybeam.description: New skill: a peculiar ray at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50); Confused 2 turns.

mewtwo-psyshock.name: Psyshock
mewtwo-psyshock.description: New skill: materializes psychic waves at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 75).

mewtwo-extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
mewtwo-extrasensory.description: New skill: an odd, unseen power strikes a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

mewtwo-psywave.name: Psywave
mewtwo-psywave.description: New skill: psychic waves hit a foe up to 2 hexes away, even out of sight (Power 85).

mewtwo-amnesia.name: Amnesia
mewtwo-amnesia.description: New skill: empties its mind to sharpen its psychic power; Focused for 2 turns.

mewtwo-disable.name: Disable
mewtwo-disable.description: New skill: seals the skills of a foe up to 2 hexes away for 2 turns (Disabled).
